pre_data_statement: Era boundaries are the plan-sec4.1 public halving-cycle calendar anchors (halvings 2020-05-11 / 2024-04-20, cycle top 2021-04, bear bottom 2022-12). They were never moved and are independent of any retrieved data. data_end and the warmup start are measured facts of the retrieval, recorded here after the data gate; the fold LAW (4 contiguous folds mapped one-to-one onto the 4 plan eras, post-warmup) was fixed before any history-wide computation.
bar_membership: a bar belongs to an era/fold by its OPEN timestamp (bar covers [open, open+1h))

fold_law.mapping: fold k == era k (4 plan eras exist, so boundaries land on era edges; no even-bar partition needed)
fold_law.warmup_exclusion: the first warmup_bars=720 hourly bars of the retrieved series (opens 2020-01-01T00:00 .. 2020-01-30T23:00) are excluded from ALL census, floors, folds and dry-runs; F1 effectively starts at the first post-warmup bar
fold_law.force_flat: fold ends force-flat: episodes are truncated at fold ends (truncated episodes counted and flagged); signal dry-runs evaluate each fold independently; any open position at a fold end is closed at that fold's last decision (flat at boundary)
fold_law.attribution_identity: per-phase fold episode counts sum to the per-phase cell total minus episodes spanning boundaries are NOT merged (each fold owns its own truncated runs); decision counts partition exactly

F1.note: start = first post-warmup bar open (bar index 720)

data_end_disclosure: DATA_END = last complete hourly bar retrieved from Vision (monthly zips 2020-01..2026-08 + daily tail for 2026-09 through the last fully published day); exact value recorded in data/manifest.json and census/census.json after the data gate.

data_end_measured.note: measured fact filled after the data gate; the fold LAW above was fixed pre-data and no boundary was moved

outcome_observed_corpus_disclosure: F4 contains 2025-08-20..2026-08-20 which overlaps the frozen V2 15m catalog (outcome-observed corpus); disclosed in every artifact; no V2 artifact is read by this lane.

floors_immutable.below_floor: NOT_RUN_THIN_PHASE for that phase x cell; strategy slot FLAT; reported with margin-to-floor; never pooled with BTC_H4 or any other cell

pit_disclosure: Vision klines are retrospective exchange snapshots (retrieved 2026-09). Bar knowable at close; first executable fill next bar open. Disclosed in every artifact.
